[P2] 把壳丢掉的
乌龟
文/图:〔日〕吉泽惠子  翻 译: 游蕾蕾

乌龟越来越讨厌背上的壳了。
这个壳让他不能蹦蹦跳跳，也不能爬树，
还常常被兔子嘲笑是“慢吞吞的乌龟”！

[P3] “只要拿掉背上这个重重的壳，我是绝对不会输给兔子的，我讨厌这个壳！”
乌龟拿掉壳，一脚踢开。喀啰喀啰，龟壳从山坡上滚了下去。

[P4] 咚！
被踢下山坡的龟壳，砸中了正在
掏蜂蜜的小熊的额头。

[P5] “好疼啊！这是什么东西？”小熊捡起龟壳，轻轻地对它吹气。
“呜——呜——”龟壳发出了柔美悦耳的声音。小熊陶醉地闭上眼睛，吹奏起龟壳，美妙的旋律在森林里传开了。
小熊很满意这个龟壳笛，决定带回家去。
可是，小熊手里提了好几罐蜂蜜，回家的路上，一不小心，又让龟壳滚了出去，喀啰喀啰！

[P6] 龟壳滚呀滚，突然一个弹跳，钩在树枝上了。
小鸟们好奇地飞过来看看。
“你们看，你们看，好棒的房子呀！”
“我们进去看看！”
“我也要看！我也要看！”
小鸟们叽叽喳喳，叽叽喳喳……

[P7] 龟壳里一下子挤进太多小鸟，树枝承受不了重量，
“咔嚓”一声，断掉了……

[P8] 扑通！龟壳掉进河里了。
正在河边玩耍的老鼠们吓了一大跳，慌慌张张地躲到大石头后面。过了一会儿，才小心地探出头来。
“吓死我了！”
“看，那好像是一艘船呢！”

[P9] 哗啦！哗啦！哗啦！哗啦！
老鼠们把龟壳当作船，神气地在河里向前划行。
“真是太酷了！”
“对啊，这艘船太棒了！”

[P10] 可是，水流越来越急，龟壳船也跟着摇摇晃晃。
扑通一声，船翻了，龟壳转呀转，跟着水流漂走了。

[P11] 这时候的乌龟，开始后悔把壳丢掉了。
原来他午睡的时候，柔软的背部被蚊子叮了好几个包，痒得受不了！

乌龟想起他的壳总是保护着他，无论是大热天，还是寒冷的夜里，都帮了好大的忙！

[P12] 乌龟四处寻找他的壳，却怎么也找不到。
“没有壳的我，应该改叫什么名字呢？是‘把壳
丢掉的乌龟’，还是‘背部被蚊子叮得好痒的乌龟’
呢？不对，不对！没有壳的我，说不定再也不能叫做
乌龟了。那我到底是什么？”
乌龟越想越害怕……

[P13] 他垂头丧气地走着，突然间闻到一股好好好香的味道，是从大树底下的屋子里传来的。
他走近屋子，听到了开心的歌声，还有脚步声，蹦！蹦！蹦！
乌龟从窗户往里头一看……

[P14] “啊——”
乌龟惊讶地大叫。
歌声也马上停了下来。
屋里的主人转过头来。

[P15] 哎呀呀呀！
刚才在屋里哼歌的，竟然是套着龟壳的兔子！

[P16] 兔子红着脸，一边小口喝着浓汤，一边告诉乌龟早上发生的事情。
他说起龟壳笛美妙动听的声音，又赞美龟壳房真漂亮，还有在河里划行的龟壳船看起来好威风。最后说到他费了好大的力气，才把龟壳从河里搬上来！

[P17] “我很羡慕你有一个这么酷的壳，所以才会老是欺负你，对不起！”兔子说着说着，眼泪也跟着掉下来。
乌龟说：“没关系啦！谢谢你把它从河里搬上来，我才能找回我的壳啊！”

乌龟马上钻进龟壳里，开心地说：

“我不用改名叫‘把壳丢掉的乌龟’，或是‘背部被蚊子叮得好痒的乌龟’啦。终于变回我自己了！”

[P18] 月光照着乌龟回家的路，也照得龟壳闪闪发亮。
这时候的乌龟，对背上的壳感到非常自豪。

full_text_en:
[P2] The Turtle Who Threw Away His Shell
Text & Illustrations: [Japan] Keiko Yoshizawa  Translator: You Leilei

The turtle was getting more and more annoyed with the shell on his back.
This shell made him unable to hop and jump, or climb trees,
and he was often mocked by the rabbit as the 'slow-moving turtle'!

[P3] "As long as I get rid of this heavy shell on my back, I will never lose to the rabbit. I hate this shell!"
Turtle took off his shell and kicked it away. Clatter clatter, the shell rolled down the hill.

[P4] Thud!
The turtle shell kicked down the hill hit the little bear's forehead as he was reaching for honey.

[P5] "Ouch! What is this thing?" The bear picked up the turtle shell and gently blew into it.
"Woo—woo—" The shell made a soft, pleasant sound. The bear closed his eyes in delight, playing the shell, and beautiful music spread through the forest.
The bear was very happy with this shell flute and decided to take it home.
But, the bear was carrying several jars of honey. On the way home, he accidentally let the shell roll away again, clattering and rolling!

[P6] The turtle shell rolled and rolled, suddenly bouncing and getting hooked on a branch.
Little birds curiously flew over to take a look.
"Look, look, what a wonderful house!"
"Let's go inside and see!"
"I want to see too! I want to see too!"
The little birds chirped and chirped, chirped and chirped...

[P7] Too many little birds crowded into the turtle shell, and the branch couldn't bear the weight.
"Snap!" went the branch, and it broke...

[P8] Plop! The turtle shell fell into the river.
The mice playing by the river were startled and hurriedly hid behind a big rock. After a while, they cautiously peeked out.
"Scared me to death!"
"Look, that looks like a little boat!"

[P9] Splash! Splash! Splash! Splash!
The mice use the turtle shell as a boat, proudly paddling forward in the river.
"This is so cool!"
"Yes, this boat is amazing!"

[P10] But the current became faster and faster, and the turtle-shell boat rocked back and forth.
With a plop, the boat flipped over, the shell spun around, and drifted away with the current.

[P11] At this moment, the turtle began to regret throwing away his shell.
When he napped, his soft back was bitten by mosquitoes, leaving several itchy bumps—he couldn’t stand it!

The turtle remembered how his shell always protected him, whether it was a hot day or a cold night—it had been such a big help!

[P12] The turtle searched everywhere for his shell, but couldn't find it.
"What should I be called without my shell? 'The turtle who lost his shell,' or 'the turtle whose back is itchy from mosquito bites'? No, no! Without my shell, I might not even be able to call myself a turtle anymore. What am I, then?"
The turtle grew more and more frightened...

[P13] He walked dejectedly, when suddenly he smelled a very, very, very delicious scent coming from the house under the big tree.
He approached the house, heard joyful singing, and the sound of footsteps, hop! hop! hop!
The turtle peeked inside from the window...

[P14] "Ah——"
Turtle cried out in surprise.
The singing stopped immediately.
The owner inside the house turned around.

[P15] Oh my! 
The one who was humming in the house just now is actually a rabbit wearing a turtle shell!

[P16] The rabbit, blushing, sipped his thick soup slowly while telling the turtle about what happened that morning.
He talked about the beautiful, melodious sound of the turtle shell flute, praised how lovely the turtle shell house looked, and admired how cool the turtle shell boat looked as it sailed on the river. Finally, he mentioned how much effort he had to use to carry the turtle shell up from the river!

[P17] "I really envy you for having such a cool shell, that's why I kept bullying you. I'm sorry!" The rabbit said, tears falling as he spoke.
Turtle said: "It's okay! Thank you for bringing it up from the river. That's how I was able to find my shell again!"

The turtle immediately crawled into his shell and happily said:

"I don't have to change my name to 'Turtle Who Lost His Shell' or 'Turtle Whose Back Itches from Mosquito Bites' anymore. I'm finally back to myself!"

[P18] Moonlight illuminates the turtle's way home, and also makes the shell shine brightly.
At this moment, the turtle feels very proud of the shell on his back.

full_summary_zh:
[P2] 本页是绘本《把壳丢掉的乌龟》的封面及第一页，介绍了乌龟因为背上的壳而感到困扰，无法自由活动，还常被兔子嘲笑。
[P3] 乌龟因讨厌背上的壳，决定将其踢掉，龟壳随后从山坡上滚落下去。
[P4] 被乌龟踢下山坡的龟壳砸中了正在掏蜂蜜的小熊的额头，小熊被蜜蜂围攻，表情痛苦。
[P5] 小熊捡到被乌龟踢下的龟壳，发现它能发出悦耳的声音，便将其当作笛子吹奏，十分喜爱。但在回家途中，因手提蜂蜜罐，不小心又让龟壳滚了出去。
[P6] 龟壳滚落时弹跳并挂在树枝上，一群小鸟飞来好奇地围观，将它误认为是漂亮的房子，叽叽喳喳地想要进去看看。
[P7] 许多小鸟挤进挂在树枝上的龟壳，导致树枝承受不住重量而断裂。
[P8] 龟壳滚落进河里，正在河边玩耍的老鼠们被吓了一跳，躲到石头后，随后好奇地探出头，误以为龟壳是一艘小船。
[P9] 老鼠们发现河里的龟壳，将其当作小船，用树枝划水，兴奋地在河中前行。
[P10] 老鼠们乘坐龟壳船在河中前行，但水流变急导致船翻，龟壳随水流漂走。
[P11] 乌龟因没有壳而被蚊子叮咬，感到非常痒，开始后悔丢掉龟壳，并回忆起壳在炎热和寒冷时对他的保护作用。
[P12] 乌龟在夜晚四处寻找丢失的龟壳，却一无所获，开始担心自己没有壳后不再算是乌龟，内心充满恐惧和不安。
[P13] 乌龟在夜晚沮丧地寻找丢失的龟壳，闻到大树下屋子里飘来的香味，走近后听到歌声和脚步声，从窗户向里张望。
[P14] 乌龟在夜晚靠近大树下的屋子，从窗户向里张望时，因屋内突然停止的歌声和主人回头的动作而惊叫。
[P15] 乌龟在夜晚靠近大树下的屋子，从窗户向里张望时，发现屋内正在唱歌的竟是一只套着龟壳的兔子，兔子被惊吓后大叫。
[P16] 兔子在屋内与乌龟共进晚餐，一边喝汤一边讲述自己早上如何发现并搬回龟壳的经历，描述了龟壳被用作笛子、房子和船的奇妙用途。
[P17] 兔子向乌龟道歉，解释自己因羡慕其龟壳而欺负他，乌龟感谢兔子找回龟壳。乌龟重新钻进龟壳，感到开心，觉得自己终于变回了真正的自己。
[P18] 乌龟在月光下回家，龟壳闪闪发亮，他为自己重新拥有龟壳而感到自豪。
